title: A purple rocket
done: Three, two, one, whoosh! Up to the moon.

steps.say: Lay it flat on the table. Top row, left to right: a gap, a red corner triangle in the bottom right, a red corner triangle in the bottom left.
Next row down, left to right: a gap, 2 purple squares.
Next row down, left to right: a gap, 2 blue squares.
Next row down, left to right: a gap, 2 purple squares.
Next row down, left to right: a gap, 2 purple squares.
Next row down, left to right: a red corner triangle in the bottom right, 2 purple squares, a red corner triangle in the bottom left.
Next row down, left to right: a red square, 2 purple squares, a red square.
Next row down, left to right: a gap, 2 orange squares.
Next row down, left to right: a gap, a yellow corner triangle in the top right, a yellow corner triangle in the top left.
